title: Aparentemente, al hacer clic en cualquier opción no funciona, hay que hacer un pequeño Swap
body: Es poco intuitivo tener que hacer un Swap en cada una de las opciones, en vez de un simple tap con el dedo
author: Seba25

title: Terrible user experience - Unusable on IOS
body:
This app performs incredibly poorly. The overall system is highly unstable, laggy, and constantly freezes. I encounter severe touch-
responsiveness issues every time I try to select an option. It is so poorly programmed that even trying to type out this review within the App Store overlay feels like a miracle because the app's background performance is dragging the whole system down. I expected much better optimization on iOS, but it has been a terrible experience. Avoid until they fix these massive performance issues.
author: Brandon-user1293
